title: Byte-equal readback on persisted artifacts
body: Round-trip every JSON/text artifact (design.md, blueprint.md, plan.md, gate decisions, audit events) before allowing the next step to consume it. Reject mismatches with a typed error. Stratum builtin: `readback_matches(path)` usable in ensure clauses. Inspired by ContextGraph Reality Loop white paper (Royse, May 2026), where every persisted artifact is byte-equal-verified before it can influence the next decision. Catches partial writes, serialization regressions, and silent FS corruption before they propagate.
